item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Jupiter Sunrise - 2002-2012
item.description:
Jupiter Sunrise was an american band from the early 2000s that shot up in popularity because of Myspace. They were featured on One Tree hill, Played at Warped Tour, and were even offically endorsed by Myspace. Unfortunately, they ended up losing that popularity just as fast. Most of their music is lost media even from the band members themselves (I've been in contact with them for about 2 years now and they fully support my search efforts!!). If anyone has any of there music, it'd be greatly appreciated if you could send it to me or upload it here.

Here are the Jupiter Sunrise songs I'm still looking for. Some of them have lyrics, some have live performances only, some demos, short clips, and acoustic versions. I'd also appreciate any live performances!!
====================
Magazines
Sleepwalker
Fillibuster
It's So Hard For Heavy Eyes
Rockets, Love, & Money
Let Go
Mira, Mira
Virginia
What's So Hard
Why'd I Wait So Long
Quarter To Four
Traveling Mages
Beautiful Girls Demo
====================
Honestly, if you have anything by JS just send it my way. Best to retread ground then potentially lose a song.
